note: Fees in India from 1 July 2026. A minor of 15 to 18 may apply as an adult, for ten years; a minor's passport is valid five years or until 18, whichever comes first, and an adult's at most ten. Fresh applications (not reissues) for children up to 8 and people over 60 get 10% off. A lost or damaged passport costs more (5000 or 6000, a minor's 4250; Tatkaal 7500, 8500 and 6750), written as replacement routes. Abroad the schedule sets the fee in dollars (USD 125 and 175, a minor's 90; Tatkaal 250, 300 and 215; lost or damaged 250, 300 and 215, Tatkaal 375, 425 and 340), the abroad routes' currency; the missions' own service charges aren't in it. The notification's PDF interleaves zero-width characters through its text layer, so it was read by eye (saved again 2026-10-30). Processing times are leads.

sources.title: Ministry of External Affairs, Notification G.S.R. 516(E), 20 June 2026: the Passports (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (Schedule IV substituted)
sources.said: (2) They shall come into force with effect from the 1st day of July, 2026 ... SCHEDULE IV ... Normal Fee Tatkaal fee (inclusive of normal fee) India Abroad India Abroad Rs. $ Rs. $ ... (a) Applicants (18 years of age and above / Minors aged between 15 to 18 years, if applied under this category): 1. For an ordinary fresh passport or reissue of passport containing 36 pages 2500 125 5000 250 2. For an ordinary fresh passport or reissue of passport containing 60 pages 3500 175 6000 300 3. For an ordinary passport in lieu of lost or damaged passport containing 36 pages 5000 250 7500 375 4. ... 60 pages 6000 300 8500 425 (b) Minor Applicants (below 18 years of age): 5. For an ordinary fresh passport or reissue of passport containing 36 pages 1750 90 4250 215 6. For an ordinary passport in lieu of lost or damaged passport containing 36 pages 4250 215 6750 340 ... Note: ... 2. The validity of passports issued under serial number I(a) shall not exceed ten years, and the validity of passports issued under serial number I(b) shall be for five years or until the applicant attains the age of 18 years, whichever is earlier. 3. There shall be a discount of ten per cent. in passport fee for fresh applications (and not for re-issue) in respect of minors up to the age of 8 years and senior citizens (persons above the age of 60 years).
